diffs.diff: header pin 1: part says GND, datasheet reading says Vcc
diffs.evidence: Adafruit joystick.sch net N$2 joins U1 pins V-, H-, SEL- with JP1 pin 1 (ground). In joystick.brd, JP1 (1X05, rot R180 at x=19.05) puts pad 1 at x=24.13, under the silkscreen text 'GND' at x=24.638. The second reading listed the silkscreen left to right (Vcc, Xout, Yout, Sel, GND), which is the reverse of header pin numbering.

diffs.diff: header pin 2: part says Sel, datasheet reading says Xout
diffs.evidence: joystick.sch net N$5 joins U1 pin SEL+ with JP1 pin 2. In joystick.brd, JP1 pad 2 is at x=21.59, under the silkscreen text 'Sel' at x=22.098. The reading's 'Xout' is the second label counted from the opposite (Vcc) end.

diffs.diff: header pin 4: part says Xout, datasheet reading says Sel
diffs.evidence: joystick.sch net N$3 joins JP1 pin 4 with U1 pin V (pot wiper). In joystick.brd, JP1 pad 4 is at x=16.51, under the silkscreen text 'Xout' at x=17.018. Yout (pad 3, x=19.05, H wiper) is at the centre and is the same in both readings.

diffs.diff: header pin 5: part says Vcc, datasheet reading says GND
diffs.evidence: joystick.sch net N$1 joins U1 pins V+ and H+ (top ends of both pots) with JP1 pin 5. In joystick.brd, JP1 pad 5 is at x=13.97, under the silkscreen text 'Vcc' at x=14.478.
